# Dated-context consumer fixtures

These are frozen outputs of the existing `engine.sector_dated_context` owner,
not a second projector. The exact owner is retained on Macro PR #10839 at
`3894ea1befb9ffe7f45e3398a1334c6c14b13a51`; its source SHA-256 is
`30fb3b21c48c2d5f0b2c82903e799968b0326f3e3f3805e7250557e6ed50bdb0`.

`dated_context_inputs_v1.json` preserves the controlled reduced inputs used by
the owner's qualified tests, including their supplied source attribution. The
current fixture is the result of `project_dated_context(**inputs)`. The
historical fixture is the same call with
`decision_cutoff="2026-10-01T20:00:00Z"`; the actual owner withholds the historical
context. The consumer helper only loads either frozen output into a fresh object.

Both outputs were generated by executing the exact owner on 2026-11-07. No
production code from the held branch was copied into this branch, and no current
or historical production availability is established by these synthetic inputs.
Positive native projection still requires integration of the actual owner from
its original carrier. These fixtures isolate UI tests from another suite's
private helper; they do not satisfy that production dependency.

Owner source:
https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/macro/blob/3894ea1befb9ffe7f45e3398a1334c6c14b13a51/engine/sector_dated_context.py
